maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue comes from new construction and installation of HVAC, electrical and plumbing systems; service is the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private commercial and industrial owners, such as data centers, manufacturers and healthcare, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mostly organic from large construction projects and existing customers, with periodic acquisitions of mechanical and electrical contractors.

mission_critical.reason: Contractors win project work through bidding and relationships, so customers can change contractors easily, though service contracts add some stickiness.

notes: Acquisitions are a recurring part of its strategy, so the serial-acquirer answer is a judgment call.
